gatoh.logging.logging.LoggerVariables.new_iteration

LoggerVariables.new_iteration(init: bool = False) → None[source]

Increment the current_iteration counter and then copy all the values from the previous iteration to their respective list indexes for the new iteration.

Parameters:

init (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the call is being made during the first model iteration (no previous values to copy)
